items.headline: Transitioning 4,200 Monthly Donors to Automated SEPA and Reducing Churn by 42%
items.summary: Horizon Aid coordinates emergency medical aid and sustainable water infrastructure. Before Donorfit, they managed thousands of individual bank transfers across multiple European countries using disparate spreadsheets.
items.challenge: Managing over 4,000 monthly donors across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland via manual bank reconciliations resulted in unrecovered failed payments, lost records, and significant administrative fatigue.
items.solution: Implemented Donorfit’s Recurring Giving and Donor Management modules with automated SEPA Direct Debit handling, automated dunning notifications, and localized tax receipting.
items.outcome: Eliminated manual CSV reconciliation, reduced involuntary donor churn to under 2.8%, and enabled staff to focus on critical field coordination in East Africa.

quote.text: Donorfit brought calm and precision to our operations. Our monthly recurring giving is predictable, and our supporters love the seamless digital experience.
quote.author: Katharina Lindemann

items.headline: Scaling Orphan & Child Sponsorship Programs While Upholding Strict Safeguarding Standards
items.summary: Dedicated to providing educational scholarships and medical checkups for orphaned children, Kinderbrücke required an audit-compliant platform to manage sponsor relationships with complete dignity.
items.challenge: Annual progress report cards and school updates were being formatted manually in Word documents, taking caseworkers months to deliver while risking data privacy breaches.
items.solution: Adopted Donorfit Orphan Sponsorship and Donor Management, enabling encrypted field casework uploads and automated sponsor progress notifications.
items.outcome: Delivered school updates to sponsors in days rather than months, achieved an 88% sponsor retention rate, and met all European child protection privacy criteria.

quote.text: Our sponsors feel genuinely connected to the children they support, and our caseworkers in the field spend their time on care rather than document reformatting.
quote.author: Dr. Michael Brandt

items.headline: Automating Annual Membership Renewals and Streamlining General Assembly Roll Calls
items.summary: Representing over 650 institutional and individual environmental members across the EU, this association struggled with delayed dues payments and out-of-date voter registries.
items.challenge: Annual membership dues required paper invoicing and weeks of phone follow-ups, causing severe delays in establishing official voter eligibility for general assemblies.
items.solution: Deployed Donorfit Membership Management with automated annual SEPA direct debit renewals and self-service member accounts.
items.outcome: Over 85% of members transitioned to automated direct debits, delinquent dues plummeted, and assembly roll calls are now compiled with one click.

quote.text: Chasing membership dues was the bane of our administrative calendar. Donorfit completely eliminated the problem in a single renewal cycle.
quote.author: Sophie Dumont
